title: Partial report shows inflation or conceptual overflow, not phenomenal overflow

statements.text: In partial report experiments, the sense of consciously seeing the identity of every letter is unwarranted and likely reflects inflated subjective perception. The results show at most that fine-grained conceptual representations overflow the working memory bottleneck.

sources.quote: On our view, subjects’ sense that they consciously see the identities of all 12 letters is unwarranted
but rather overflow of the working-memory bottleneck by fine-grained conceptual representations
